_comment: Kit-level build config: what gets baked into the sandbox image. Not per project,
not secret — trim it so a sandbox carries the tools you actually use.
'harnesses' are the CLIs a project may pick (opencode | claude | codex | copilot); a
project's HARNESS= must be one of them. 'stacks' names the STACK= values and the
components each one installs (node | python | java | angular | dotnet); node is
required by the harness CLIs and Angular. Version pins stay in .env.
Playwright + headless Chromium is not a kit setting: a project opts in with
COMPONENTS=playwright (added to its stack's set; the wizard asks), default off.
Each stack's components also decide its egress whitelist blocks (node ->
stack-node, python -> stack-python, java -> stack-java, dotnet -> stack-dotnet).
A project's COMPONENTS= overrides its stack's set (build args AND blocks), and
only the project's ONE HARNESS is installed — so
'harnesses' is the set a project may pick from, not what every image carries.
A project with no config gets the first-launch wizard (at a terminal) or a
AIRLOCK_KIT_CONFIG=<path> points airlock at a different file.
